description:
The Input component's `handle_key/2` dispatches via hardcoded `%Key{}` pattern matches. This means user keybinding overrides have no effect on editor behavior. Upstream's Editor component dispatches through the KeybindingsManager.

Refactor Input.handle_key to accept a `Keybindings` struct (threaded through Interactive state) and use `Keybindings.matches?/3` for all editor actions instead of raw pattern matching. Keep the multi-head function style but match on action names rather than key structs.

This is a prerequisite for user keybinding customization (ticket 8) to actually work end-to-end.

Ref: `editor.ts` handleInput method.
title: Input: use Keybindings instead of hardcoded Key patterns
